user

Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

The room is filled with officials, reporters, and cameras. A large banner reads "WORLD RECORD HOLDER" in bold letters. At the center of the room, a frail but determined 127-year-old man, GEORGE, stands proudly, his eyes shining with tears.

GEORGE
(whispering to himself)
I Did It. I Really Did It.

The officials approach George, presenting him with a certificate and a gold medal.

OFFICIAL
Mr. George, Congratulations! You have been officially recognized as the Oldest Human to Ever Live.

GEORGE
(smiling)
Thank You. Thank You So Much.

The room erupts in applause as George is mobbed by reporters and well-wishers.

CUT TO:

INT. GEORGE'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

George lies in bed, his eyes fixed on the ceiling. He takes a deep breath, and his mind begins to wander back to his youth.

GEORGE
(whispering to himself)
Quantum Immortality... I Remember Reading About It Online...

Suddenly, his eyes glaze over, and his expression changes. He becomes distant, lost in thought.

GEORGE
(whispering)
If I'm Immortal... If I've Been Alive for 127 Years... What Does That Mean?

His voice rises, and his words become a stream-of-consciousness monologue.

GEORGE
(whispering)
I've Been Alive For So Long... I've Seen Empires Rise And Fall... I've Met People Who Are Now Long Gone... But I'm Still Here... Still Alive...

His words become a frantic chant.

GEORGE
(whispering)
Quantum Immortality... It's Real... It's True... I'm The Only One Who Knows...

George's body begins to shake, and his eyes roll back in his head. He starts to laugh maniacally, his voice rising to a crescendo.

GEORGE
(whispering)
I'M THE ONLY ONE WHO KNOWS... I'M THE ONLY ONE WHO'S BEEN ALIVE FOR 127 YEARS... I'M THE ONLY ONE WHO'S SEEN THE TRUTH...

The camera zooms in on George's face, his eyes wild and unhinged. The sound of his laughter echoes through the room, growing louder and more intense.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

INT. GEORGE'S BEDROOM - LATER

George lies in bed, his body still shaking. His eyes are open, but his gaze is unfocused. He's lost in a world of his own making.

GEORGE
(whispering)
I'm Not Alone... I'm Not Alone...

The camera lingers on George's face, his expression a mixture of terror and despair.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. GEORGE'S HOUSE - DAY

The camera pans across the quiet suburban street, the sun shining down on the houses. The sound of birds chirping fills the air.

Suddenly, a figure appears in the distance. It's George, walking down the street, his eyes fixed on the horizon.

GEORGE
(whispering)
I'm Not Alone... I'm Not Alone...

The camera follows George as he walks, the sound of his footsteps echoing through the silence.

FADE TO BLACK.
